note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/sign-in.reason: cinatra#1628 (PR #1778) S11c dashboardContribution hardening. The two net-new @cinatra-ai/dashboards modules — packages/dashboards/src/contribution-upgrade-merge.ts (the baseline-backed 3-way upgrade-merge keyed on the stable portlet instanceId; never clobbers user customization) and packages/dashboards/src/extension/portlet-link-guard.ts (the two-layer URL/link guard: an allowlist on URL-bearing keys plus an ALWAYS-scan javascript:/vbscript:/blob:/data: denylist, wired fail-closed into the single assertConfigV12 write/install validator) — are imported by already-reachable dashboards modules (extension-materialization + the config write validator), so both become first-party-reachable wherever @cinatra-ai/dashboards is reached. That package sits in the shared route graph reachable from every tracked route, so each route picks up exactly +2 (byOwner @cinatra-ai/dashboards 29->31). NOT narrowable barrel imports: each is a distinct net-new hardening module at a SINGLE enforcement boundary (the link guard is the one write-boundary check; the 3-way merge is the single upgrade writer) — inlining to dodge the edge would defeat the single-enforcement design. MEASURED via an A/B differential (revert PR #1778 dashboards/boot changes to origin/main, re-measure) with the companion extension repos cloned pinned (missingCount 0, exactly as CI does via clone-extensions): a clean +2 (1486->1488). Re-raises the PR #1784 field-renderer ceiling for this route by +2 (a re-raise replaces the record it layers on).
